question: For each subdomain, list which regulations cover it and how many clauses each contributes
cypher: MATCH (r:Regulation)-[:HAS_CLAUSE]->(c:Clause)-[:MAPPED_TO]->(sd:SubDomain) WITH sd.subDomainId AS subDomainId, sd.name AS subDomainName, collect({ regulationId: r.regulationId, clauseCount: count(c), totalNormativeIntensity: sum(c.normativeIntensity) }) AS regulationsData UNWIND regulationsData AS regData WITH subDomainId, subDomainName, collect({ regulation: regData.regulationId, clauses: regData.clauseCount, normativeIntensity: regData.totalNormativeIntensity }) AS coveringRegulations RETURN sd.subDomainId, sd.name, coveringRegulations ORDER BY sd.subDomainId, [reg IN coveringRegulations | reg.regulation][0];
